en.t: Yes. That is exactly how it is.

units.source_text: 我出生在港市，可这里是温泉浴场。”姑娘出乎意外地用坦率的口吻说，“

en.t: I was born in a port town, but this place is a hot-spring resort,” the girl said in an unexpectedly frank tone, “

units.source_text: 客人大多是游客，虽然我还是个孩子，听过形形色色的人说，

en.t: Most of the guests are travelers, and though I am still just a child, from listening to all sorts of people talk,

units.source_text: 那些人心里十分喜欢你而当面又不说，总使你依依不舍，流连忘返。

en.t: it seems the ones who like you very much in their hearts but never say so to your face are the ones who leave you longing for them, unable to forget.

units.source_text: 即使分别之后，也还是那个样。

en.t: Even after you have parted, it is still that way.

units.source_text: 对方有时想起你，给你写信的，大体都是属于这类人。”

en.t: When the other person sometimes remembers you and writes you letters, they are generally that sort of person.”
